build_LMMamba_model: build a language model using LMMamba with token embeddings, RMSNorm, and configurable output layer
create_StateCache_module: create a StateCache module to register conv_cache and state_cache buffers for Mamba state tracking
run_LMMamba_forward: run the LMMamba forward pass with token values and optional targets to get logits or cross-entropy loss
calculate_flops_per_token: calculate the number of FLOPs per token using get_num_flop_per_token with model params and sequence length
get_activation_checkpointing_ops: get the set of no-recompute ops for activation checkpointing including mm and ssm operations
